description: Paid $0.05 per call: read one public web page and get it back as clean text — title plus paragraph blocks, markup/script/style/iframe removed, capped at 12,000 characters and honest about it in `truncated`. The Indonesian entity dictionary and sentiment lexicon behind indonesia_sentiment then run over that text and come back with their matched terms (no LLM; sentiment is null with a reason when the page declares a non-Indonesian lang rather than a invented score). Safe by construction: only public http/https targets — any host whose DNS answer includes a loopback, private, CGNAT, link-local, cloud-metadata or reserved address is refused, connections go to that validated IP, redirects are never followed, the body is cut at 1.5 MB and only text/html, text/plain, text/markdown, application/json and application/xml are parsed.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL. No credentials in the URL, no ports other than 80/443, no private or metadata targets — all refused before payment.

name: web_read
